import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    bg=grid[0][0]; fg=next((v for row in grid for v in row if v!=bg), bg); mark=2
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]!=bg: continue
            if ((c>0 and c+1<w and grid[r][c-1]==fg and grid[r][c+1]==fg) or
                (r>0 and r+1<h and grid[r-1][c]==fg and grid[r+1][c]==fg)):
                out[r][c]=mark
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
